title: Corrected Forecast Combinations
abstract: arXiv:2601.09999v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes corrected forecast combinations when the original combined forecast errors are serially dependent. Motivated by the classic Bates and Granger (1969) example, we show that combined forecast errors can be strongly autocorrelated and that a simple correction, which adds a fraction of the previous combined error to the next-period combined forecast, can deliver sizable improvements in forecast accuracy, often exceeding the original gains from combining. We formalize the approach within the conditional-risk framework of Gibbs and Vasnev (2024), in which the combined error decomposes into a predictable component (measurable at the forecast origin) and an innovation. We then link this correction to efficient estimation of combination weights under time-series dependence via GLS, allowing joint estimation of weights and an error-covariance structure. translated_abstract: 本文提出了当原始组合预测误差存在序列相关性时的修正预测组合方法。受经典的 Bates 和 Granger（1969）例子的启发，我们表明组合预测误差可能具有很强的自相关性，而一种简单的修正方法——将上一期组合误差的一部分加到下一期的组合预测中——能够带来可观的预测精度提升，且这种提升往往超过组合本身带来的原始收益。我们在 Gibbs 和 Vasnev（2024）的条件风险框架内对该方法进行了形式化，其中组合误差被分解为一个可预测成分（在预测起点可测）和一个新息。随后，我们通过广义最小二乘法（GLS）将这一修正与时间序列相依情形下组合权重的有效估计联系起来，从而能够对权重和误差协方差结构进行联合估计。利用美国专业预测者调查数据对主要宏观经济（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出一种修正预测组合方法：当组合预测误差存在序列相关时，将上一期组合误差的一部分加入下一期预测中可显著提升预测精度，并可通过GLS对组合权重与误差协方差结构进行联合估计。
